lines.text: Hi, I'm Sindy! Welcome to sind, Slurm in Docker.
In this quick start, we'll create a complete Slurm cluster on your own machine. It takes about a minute, and all you need is Docker.
With one command, sind sets up the network, DNS and SSH, generates the munge key and Slurm configuration, and starts every node as a container.
Let's try it! Run sind create cluster, and you get a cluster named default, with one controller and one worker.
sind stays quiet when everything works. Now, sind get clusters shows that it's up and running.
That's it! Your cluster is ready for jobs. See you in the next guide!
